targets.expression:
filter @message like "Method completed with status"
| parse @message "(*) Method completed with status: *" as MessageID, HTTP_Status
| stats count(MessageID) as API_Count by HTTP_Status 
| sort HTTP_Status asc

FILTER @message LIKE "HTTP Method:"
| PARSE @message "(*) HTTP Method: *, Resource Path: *"  as API_id, Method, Resource_Path
| FILTER Method IN ["POST", "GET"]
| STATS COUNT(API_id) AS API_Count by API_id, Method, Resource_Path
| SORT BY API_id, Method, Resource_Path
| DISPLAY API_id, Method, Resource_Path, API_Count

filter @message like "Method completed with status"
| parse @message "(*) Method completed with status: *" as MessageID, HTTP_Status
| stats COUNT(*) AS HTTP_TOTAL
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 200 AND HTTP_Status < 300) AS HTTP_2XX
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 300 AND HTTP_Status < 400) AS HTTP_3XX
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 400 AND HTTP_Status < 500) AS HTTP_4XX
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 500 AND HTTP_Status < 600) AS HTTP_5XX

fields status as HTTP_Status, apiKey as API_Key, latency as Latency
| filter @message like "httpMethod" and not isblank(status)
| sort @timestamp desc
| stats count(HTTP_Status) as API_Count by HTTP_Status, API_Key, Latency
| sort HTTP_Status asc

fields path as Path, status as HTTP_Status
| filter @message like "httpMethod" and not isblank(status)
| parse path "/v1/*/" as Endpointpath
| sort @timestamp desc
| stats count(HTTP_Status) as API_Count, count(*) as TotalAPI_Count by Endpointpath, Path, HTTP_Status
| sort HTTP_Status asc

fields path as Path, status as HTTP_Status
| filter @message like "httpMethod" and not isblank(status)
| parse path "/v1/*/" as Endpointpath
| sort path asc
| stats COUNT(*) AS HTTP_TOTAL
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 200 AND HTTP_Status < 300) AS HTTP_2XX
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 400 AND HTTP_Status < 500) AS HTTP_4XX
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 500 AND HTTP_Status < 600) AS HTTP_5XX 
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 200 AND HTTP_Status < 300) / HTTP_TOTAL AS HTTP_2XX_Rate
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 400 AND HTTP_Status < 500) / HTTP_TOTAL AS HTTP_4XX_Rate
, SUM(HTTP_Status >= 500 AND HTTP_Status < 600) / HTTP_TOTAL AS HTTP_5XX_Rate
by Endpointpath, Path

filter @message like "Received response. Status"
| parse @message "(*) Received response. Status: *, Integration latency: * ms" as MessageID, Status, ElapsedMilliseconds
| stats avg(ElapsedMilliseconds) as Avg_IntegrationLatency by bin($period)
| sort Avg_IntegrationLatency desc
| limit 1

filter @message like "Received response. Status"
| parse @message "(*) Received response. Status: *, Integration latency: * ms" as MessageID, Status, IntegrationLatency
| display MessageID, IntegrationLatency
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT AVG(IntegrationLatency) FROM "AWS/ApiGateway" GROUP BY Route ORDER BY AVG() ASC
